start.text: It's contained. The site can breathe again, but it is not fixed yet.
start.name: Joshua

A.text: Good work. But stopped is not fixed. The door is still easy to crowd, and some real customers were turned away.
A.name: Carla

B.text: The flood also ran the server hot for an hour. Hardware gets hurt too.
B.name: Carla

C1.text: Walk through the office and look for machines marked with a [b][color=red]![/color][/b]. The limit first, then block the attackers, then the rack and the fan.
C1.name: Carla

C2.text: Yes. A short, honest notice on the site. It was slow, it is fixed, and we are sorry.
C2.name: Carla

D.text: Fix one thing at a time. When everything is repaired, we run a [b][color=green]final check[/color][/b].
D.name: Carla

E.text: Got it. Set the limit, block only what I have checked, cool the room, and check that real customers get in.
E.name: Joshua
